=== RIP-relative with a trailing immediate, legacy and VEX and EVEX
cmpps $3, data(%rip), %xmm1
vcmpps $3, data(%rip), %ymm1, %ymm2
vpternlogd $0xff, data(%rip), %zmm1, %zmm2
vpcmpd $1, data(%rip), %zmm1, %k1
ret
data:
.quad 0
=== RIP-relative broadcast is never disp8-compressed
vaddps data(%rip){1to16}, %zmm1, %zmm2
ret
data:
.long 0
=== AVX-512 in a loop body
top:
vmovups (%rdi,%rax,4), %zmm0 {%k1}{z}
vpaddd (%rsi){1to16}, %zmm0, %zmm0
vmovups %zmm0, (%rdx,%rax,4) {%k1}
addq $16, %rax
cmpq %rcx, %rax
jb top
vzeroupper
ret
=== Intel syntax: MMX, 3DNow! and SSE
.intel_syntax noprefix
paddb mm2, mm1
pfadd mm2, qword ptr [rax]
movq mm0, rax
movq xmm1, xmm0
movd xmm0, dword ptr [rax]
addps xmm2, xmmword ptr [rax]
addss xmm2, dword ptr [rax+8]
addsd xmm2, qword ptr [rax]
cmpps xmm2, xmm1, 3
pshufd xmm2, xmm1, 0x1b
cvtsi2sd xmm1, rax
cvtsi2ss xmm1, dword ptr [rax]
pextrd eax, xmm0, 1
pinsrq xmm0, rax, 1
crc32 eax, byte ptr [rax]
crc32 rax, qword ptr [rax]
popcnt rax, rbx
=== Intel syntax: AVX and gathers
.intel_syntax noprefix
vaddps ymm3, ymm2, ymm1
vaddps ymm3, ymm2, ymmword ptr [rax+8]
vmovaps xmm1, xmm9
vgatherdps xmm3, [rax+xmm1*4], xmm2
vgatherqps xmm3, dword ptr [rax+ymm1*4], xmm2
vpblendvb xmm3, xmm2, xmm1, xmm4
vfmadd231sd xmm3, xmm2, qword ptr [rax]
vinsertf128 ymm3, ymm2, xmm1, 1
=== Intel syntax: AVX-512 decorators
.intel_syntax noprefix
vaddps zmm3 {k1} {z}, zmm2, zmm1
vaddps zmm3, zmm2, zmm1, {rn-sae}
vaddps zmm3, zmm2, zmmword ptr [rax+64]
vaddps zmm3, zmm2, dword ptr [rax]{1to16}
vaddpd zmm3, zmm2, qword ptr [rax+8]{1to8}
vpaddd zmm3, zmm2, dword ptr [rax]{1to16}
vcmpps k1 {k2}, zmm2, zmm1, 0
vcmpps k1, zmm2, zmm1, {sae}, 0
vpcmpeqd k3 {k4}, zmm2, zmm1
vgatherdps zmm2 {k1}, [rax+zmm1*4]
vgatherdps zmm2 {k1}, dword ptr [rax+zmm17*4+8]
vscatterdps [rax+zmm1*4] {k1}, zmm2
kmovw k2, k1
kmovw k1, word ptr [rax]
kandw k3, k2, k1
vmovdqu64 zmm2 {k5}, zmmword ptr [rax]
vpternlogd zmm3, zmm2, zmm1, 0xff
vpbroadcastd zmm2, eax
vextracti64x4 ymmword ptr [rax+32], zmm1, 1
=== 32-bit mode: SSE, VEX and EVEX without extension bits
.code32
paddb %mm1, %mm2
movq %mm1, %mm2
movq %xmm0, %xmm1
addps (%eax), %xmm1
pfadd %mm1, %mm2
vaddps %ymm1, %ymm2, %ymm3
vaddps 8(%eax), %ymm2, %ymm3
vpermq $1, %ymm1, %ymm2
vgatherdps %xmm2, (%eax,%xmm1,4), %xmm3
vaddps %zmm1, %zmm2, %zmm3 {%k1}
vmovaps 64(%eax), %zmm0
kmovw %k1, %k2
